author: XamOps Team
description: Parameter-only seed manifest for the 32 Terraform scripts (Task 4.5). Unlike the bash/python/ansible manifests, the Terraform DevOpsScript rows (name, description, code, etc.) are already inserted by terraform_scripts_seed.sql. This manifest supplies only the ScriptParameter metadata for each script, matched to the existing DevOpsScript row by its unique 'name'. The bulk-import task (4.6) detects parametersOnly=true, skips code-file loading, looks up each script by name, and upserts its ScriptParameter rows. Every {{PLACEHOLDER}} in a script's code has exactly one matching entry here. parameterType is one of text/number/select/multiselect/boolean/region/instanceType; category is one of infrastructure/configuration/security/networking; prefillFrom is one of userProfile/cloudAccount/previousUsage.
